title: Is this the right stop?
setting: Maya is on a light-rail car with a backpack, watching the stops go by. She asks a passenger, Keisha, as the train starts to slow.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Sorry, is this the right stop for the museum?
lines.spoken: Sorry, is this the right stop for the museum?

lines.speaker: keisha
lines.text: The art museum? I think you want the next one.
lines.spoken: The art museum? I think you want the next one.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The next one. Not this one.
lines.spoken: The next one. Not this one.

lines.speaker: keisha
lines.text: Yeah, this is like... this is the park. You want the one after, it says 'Civic' or something on the sign.
lines.spoken: Yeah, this is like... this is the park. You want the one after, it says 'Civic' or something on the sign.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Civic. Okay. Thank you. I was about to get off.
lines.spoken: Civic. Okay. Thank you. I was about to get off.

lines.speaker: keisha
lines.text: I almost did that yesterday, different line. The names are not helpful.
lines.spoken: I almost did that yesterday, different line. The names are not helpful.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: They're really not. So I just stay on, one more?
lines.spoken: They're really not. So I just stay on, one more?

lines.speaker: keisha
lines.text: One more. You'll see a big glass building on the left. That's how I know.
lines.spoken: One more. You'll see a big glass building on the left. That's how I know.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Big glass building. Got it. Thanks, I appreciate it.
lines.spoken: Big glass building. Got it. Thanks, I appreciate it.

lines.speaker: keisha
lines.text: You're good. It's coming up quick, so, you know, start moving when it slows down.
lines.spoken: You're good. It's coming up quick, so, you know, start moving when it slows down.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I will. Is the door on this side, or the other side? I never guess right.
lines.spoken: I will. Is the door on this side, or the other side? I never guess right.

lines.speaker: keisha
lines.text: This side, I think. Yeah. I'll get off here, actually, so... you just stay put.
lines.spoken: This side, I think. Yeah. I'll get off here, actually, so... you just stay put.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Stay put. I can do that. Thanks again.
lines.spoken: Stay put. I can do that. Thanks again.

lines.speaker: keisha
lines.text: Yep. Museum's worth it, by the way. If that's where you're going.
lines.spoken: Yep. Museum's worth it, by the way. If that's where you're going.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's the plan. Okay. I'll wait for the glass building.
lines.spoken: That's the plan. Okay. I'll wait for the glass building.

gist.askZh: Maya 想在这站下吗？对不对？
gist.askEn: Does Maya want to get off here, and should she?
How will she know the right stop?
accept: big glass building on the left

details.askZh: 这一站大概是什么地方？
门在哪一侧？Keisha 自己在这站下吗？
details.askEn: Which side is the door on, and is Keisha getting off here?

glue.span: is this the right stop for the museum
glue.hear: is this the right stop for the museum
glue.noteZh: is this the right 四个小词连成一串，for the 又弱，听者容易只抓住 museum 而丢掉‘是不是这站’。
glue.standard: is this the right stop for the museum

glue.span: I think you want the next one
glue.hear: I think you want the next one
glue.noteZh: you want the 弱读连读，next one 才是关键；不要听成 I think you want this one。
glue.standard: I think you want the next one

glue.span: I was about to get off
glue.hear: I was about to get off
glue.noteZh: was about to 常听成 was abouta，表示‘差点就下了’；to 几乎消失。
glue.standard: I was about to get off

chunks.form: Is this the right stop for the museum?

chunks.sayAfter: Sorry, is this the right stop for the museum?

chunks.form: I think you want the next one.
chunks.meaningZh: 我觉得你应该坐下一站。
chunks.sayAfter: The art museum? I think you want the next one.

chunks.form: I was about to get off.
chunks.sayAfter: Thank you. I was about to get off.

roleplay.setupZh: 你坐在城市轻轨或地铁上，车开始减速，你不确定这是不是博物馆那一站。向旁边的人确认，并问下一站怎么认、门在哪一侧。
roleplay.aiRole: Keisha, a regular rider, friendly and a little wry about the useless stop names. She's getting off at the park. She'll give you a landmark (the glass building) and tell you to stay put.
variants: It actually is the right stop after all.
Keisha is not sure either and they check a map.
The next stop comes very fast.
mustUse: I think you want the next one
I was about to get off
starters: Sorry, is this the right stop for the museum?
Do I want this one or the next one?
I was about to get off.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲车上这段问路：Maya 差点在哪下，正确的站叫什么、看什么标志，Keisha 让她做什么。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the onboard ask: which stop Maya almost took, the name and landmark for the right one, and what Keisha told her to do. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
